name: --help

options.description: Interpret PATTERN as a basic regular expression (BRE, see below)

name: -e
--regexp
options.description: Use PATTERN as the pattern

--ignore-case
-y
options.description: Ignore case distinctions in both the PATTERN and the input files

name: -v
--invert-match
options.description: Invert the sense of matching, to select non-matching lines

name: -w
--word-regexp
options.description: Select only those lines containing matches that form whole words

name: -x
--line-regexp
options.description: Select only those matches that exactly match the whole line

name: -c
--count
options.description: Suppress normal output; instead print a count of matching lines for each input file

options.description: Surround the matched (non-empty) strings, matching lines, context lines, file names, line numbers, byte offse…

--files-without-match
options.description: Suppress normal output; instead print the name of each input file from which no output would normally have be…

--max-count
options.description: Stop reading a file after NUM matching lines

--only-matching
options.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of a matching line, with each such part on a separate output line

name: -q
--quiet
--silent
options.description: Quiet; do not write anything to standard output

--no-messages
options.description: Suppress error messages about nonexistent or unreadable files

--with-filename
options.description: Print the file name for each match

options.description: Display input actually coming from standard input as input coming from file LABEL

name: -n
--line-number
options.description: Prefix each line of output with the 1-based line number within its input file

options.description: Output a zero byte (the ASCII NUL character) instead of the character that normally follows a file name

--after-context
options.description: Print num lines of trailing context after each match

name: -B
--before-context
options.description: Print num lines of leading context before each match

--context
options.description: Print NUM lines of output context

--text
options.description: Treat all files as ASCII text

options.description: Controls searching and printing of binary files
